1use skrifa::raw::TableProvider;
2
3use crate::color::rgb;

8pub(crate) fn has_svg_data(font: &Font, glyph: GlyphId) -> bool {
9    font.font_ref()
10        .svg()
11        .map(|svg_table| svg_table.glyph_data(glyph.to_skrifa()).is_ok())
12        .is_ok()
13}
14
15/// Draw an SVG-based glyph on a surface.
16pub(crate) fn draw_glyph(
17    font: Font,
18    context_color: rgb::Color,
19    glyph: GlyphId,
20    surface: &mut Surface,
21) -> Option<()> {
22    let svg_data = font
23        .font_ref()
24        .svg()
25        .and_then(|svg_table| svg_table.glyph_data(glyph.to_skrifa()))
26        .ok()??;
27
28    let upem = font.units_per_em();
29
30    let fn_ = surface.sc.serialize_settings().render_svg_glyph_fn;
31    fn_(svg_data, context_color, glyph, (upem, upem), surface)?;
32
33    Some(())
34}
